body:
Adds two networks (Exploren and Wevolt, no typical price yet) and adds 10 operators from the charger file to the `match` lists of existing networks. No typical prices changed.

### New networks

| Network | Change | Source and what it says |
|---|---|---|
| `exploren` (Exploren) | New: match `exploren`, `engie`; `typicalPerKWh` null, basis `none`; `siteReading` `forbidden` | [The Driven, 8 Apr 2025](https://thedriven.io/2025/04/08/evse-acquires-engies-australian-and-new-zealand-ev-charging-network/): EVSE (Exploren) bought ENGIE's Australian network and moved it into the Exploren app. Exploren's own site is on the do-not-read list, so it wasn't read. |
| `wevolt` (Wevolt) | New: match `wevolt`, `electrona`; `typicalPerKWh` null, basis `none`; `siteReading` `unchecked` | [wevolt.com.au/drivers](https://wevolt.com.au/drivers): drivers pay in the Wevolt app; "independent operators set their own prices". [electrona.au](https://electrona.au/): Electrona's Tasmanian chargers take a card or the Wevolt app. |

### Operators added to existing networks

| Operator (fast sites) | Added to | Old → new `match` addition | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yurika (49), Queensland Electric Super Highway (6) | `chargefox` | + `yurika`, `queensland electric super highway` | [Yurika QESH page](https://www.yurika.com.au/capability/qld-electric-super-highway/): "To get charging you'll need the Chargefox App" |
| Charging the Regions (25) | `evie` | + `charging the regions` | [CVGA](https://www.cvga.org.au/charging-the-regions.html): "Evie Networks contracted for operation and maintenance of the installed chargers" |
| RAA (13) | `chargefox` | + `raa` | [RAA charging stations](https://www.raa.com.au/motor/motoring-services/ev-charging-stations) and The Driven (2 Mar 2023): RAA Charge sites are found, started and paid for in the Chargefox app |
| Electric Highway Tasmania (6) | `chargefox` | + `electric highway tasmania` | Several PlugShare listings and forum posts agree: pay with the Chargefox app or card (some sites also take credit cards) |
| WA EV Network (4), EV Highway (Horizon Power) (3) | `chargefox` | + `wa ev network`, `horizon power` | Horizon Power fees page (search excerpt; a direct fetch returned 403): "pay via the Chargefox app or credit card", DC $0.60/kWh for 2026/27, the same as Chargefox's current typical price |
| Woolworths (4) | `chargefox` | + `woolworths` | [The Driven, 14 May 2025](https://thedriven.io/2025/05/14/australian-ev-charging-platform-partners-with-retail-giants-rewards-program/): Woolworths' own chargers are on the Chargefox app |

`updated` is now 2026-11-19. `format.mjs` and `validate.mjs` both pass.

### Things to check

- **`raa` is a short match string.** It could catch a site whose name happens to contain "raa". I found no conflict, but I couldn't search the charger file for this.
- **`woolworths`:** some chargers at Woolworths car parks belong to other networks (for example, an Evie site near a Woolworths). Any of those named "Woolworths…" would get Chargefox's price unless their operator field matches the other network first.
- **Charging the Regions:** Wellington Shire says a few of its council sites use Chargefox, not Evie. Most CTR sites are Evie.
- **Wevolt `siteReading`:** its robots.txt blocks AI training crawlers (including ClaudeBot) but allows answer agents. Its /terms page wasn't checked, so it's left as `unchecked`.
- **Exploren price:** a third-party site lists individual Exploren sites at $0.35–0.70/kWh (checked 24 Oct 2026). Those figures come from Exploren's own charger finder, which we may not read, so no typical price was set.
- **Prices:** no source I'm allowed to read showed a change to any network's typical price. The Evie FAQ gives only per-charge costs, and the NRMA page returned 403. Every `checked` date is 2026-10-27, under six months old, so no price-check issue was opened.
- No web page contained instructions aimed at the agent.
title: Add Exploren and Wevolt; map 10 operators to existing networks
